title: cell
description: The basic unit of life: a membrane-bounded assembly of molecules running a self-sustaining reaction network (metabolism). The first level at which a molecular system closes into a self-maintaining compartment — the first settling toward life. Single cells are whole organisms; many differentiate into the tissues of a multicellular one. Generated by assembling molecules.

membrane.description: a boundary separating an interior chemistry from the environment

metabolism.description: a self-sustaining network of enzyme-catalyzed molecular reactions

self-maintaining.description: the network maintains and rebuilds the cell's own components
